subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should `/control-ui-config.json` use a hard 15-second per-auth-candidate deadline that silently falls back to defaults for slower responses?
rationale: The existing contract has no documented deadline, and the patch changes accepted deployment latency and runtime-metadata fallback behavior; the submitted proof validates mechanics but cannot choose that compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve bounded fallback
options.body: Accept the 15-second per-candidate cutoff and default-config fallback as the supported Control UI behavior.

options.title: Use one operation budget
options.body: Revise the implementation to compose caller cancellation with one owner-selected deadline shared across all authentication candidates.

options.title: Preserve unbounded waiting
options.body: Reject the timeout until a different recovery contract is designed for slow authenticated deployments.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded fallback
recommendation.body: Accept the 15-second per-candidate cutoff and default-config fallback as the supported Control UI behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Control UI work makes this person the strongest available owner for the bootstrap compatibility choice.
